comment: Performance budgets (milliseconds) for tests/Ample.Core.Tests/PerformanceTests.cs. Each is a generous multiple of the baseline measured on the development machine (see docs/release.md), so a slow CI machine passes and a real regression fails. Raise a budget only with a note in docs/release.md.
baselineMeasured: 2026-10-03, Windows 11, the development machine (not a CI runner), Release-like Debug build of the test project
browserNote: Budgets of spec-tests/parity/playlist-perf.spec.ts: a song of 114 blocks over 200 bars (16 lines, 117 rows and 272 clips when every line is open). The first four are the time of a draw of the Playlist (data-render-ms), the last is a keyboard move of a clip until the text has changed. Measured 2026-11-05 on the development machine; raise a budget only with a note in docs/release.md.
